usageNotes: Use this to list all Gotify push-notification endpoints configured at the cluster level. The caller must hold the `Mapping.Audit` privilege on `/mapping/notifications`; API tokens are supported. Each returned entry includes the endpoint name (used as the identifier in notification matchers), the target server URL, enabled/disabled state, and whether the entry is user-created or built-in.

examples.summary: List all Gotify endpoints in the cluster

tips: The `name` field (format: pve-configid) is the stable identifier used when referencing this endpoint in notification matchers or rules — note it down for use with related create/update/delete operations.
Entries with `disable: true` exist in config but will not receive notifications; check this field when troubleshooting missing alerts.
The `origin` field distinguishes user-created endpoints from built-in or modified-built-in ones; built-in endpoints cannot be deleted.
